description.message: Collect the page you’re viewing, images on it, and selected text into Piyi. Also opens pages that need sign-in or scripts in the background for Piyi, and fetches subtitles that require sign-in.

notConnected.message: Not connected to Piyi. Open the Piyi app and try again

savedQueued.message: Saved; Piyi will collect it when it opens

savedLater.message: Saved; Piyi will collect it shortly

readerLine1.message: Piyi reads pages in this window in the background

readerLine2.message: It closes itself after a few idle minutes
